shots.prompt: He walks into the elevator from the bright hall and turns to face the doors. Smooth slow push-in. Nobody speaks. No music, no text on screen.
His finger presses the round floor button and it lights up softly. Close-up, gentle camera. Nobody speaks. No music, no text on screen.
She stands calmly with her hands folded, breathing slowly, simply waiting. Slow push-in. Nobody speaks. No music, no text on screen.
He checks his watch, shifts his weight, taps his foot lightly and looks at the still-open doors, restless. Slow handheld camera. Nobody speaks. No music, no text on screen.
He quickly presses the door-close button twice in a row, click click. Close-up. Nobody speaks. No music, no text on screen.
The steel doors slowly close by themselves while she waits without moving. Calm, steady camera. Nobody speaks. No music, no text on screen.
She hears footsteps and turns her head toward the hall, then gently reaches out and holds the door open with a kind face. Nobody speaks. No music, no text on screen.
Both stand still in the quiet elevator; they glance at each other once and give a small polite nod, then look forward again. Nobody speaks. No music, no text on screen.

He presses the door-close button, the doors do not move, he waits a moment, lets out a small sigh and presses it once more; the doors finally start to close. Nobody speaks. No music, no text on screen.
The doors open; she steps out onto the bright floor, looks back over her shoulder and smiles warmly at the camera. Nobody speaks. No music, no text on screen.
